verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page says developers can manage Jira issues inside Bitbucket through a built-in Jira UI. It also says they can open Jira tickets from the PR screen, and that issue keys in commits update Jira statuses automatically. That covers the core of managing external tracker items from the code hosting UI. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of which operations are supported in the embedded UI (editing, transitions, comments), support for trackers other than Jira, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
